# A book carrying the shapes the beancount export has a line for and nothing
# had: accounts with a code and a description, a transaction numbered but not
# described, one carrying a receipt link, and a split of zero.
2024-01-01 commodity XCD
	mnemonic: "XCD"
	fullname: "East Caribbean Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100

2024-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "XCD"
2024-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: "Bank"
	code: "1001"
	description: "Operating account"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "XCD"
2024-01-01 open Expenses
	type: "Expense"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "XCD"
2024-01-01 open Expenses:Sundry
	type: "Expense"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "XCD"

# Numbered and not described — a cheque written into the ledger before anyone
# said what it was for.
2024-02-01 * "CHK-1001" ""
	Assets:Bank -25.00 XCD
	Expenses:Sundry 25.00 XCD

# Carrying a link to the scan of the receipt.
2024-02-02 * "Stationery"
	doc_link: "file:///receipts/2024-02-02.pdf"
	Assets:Bank -15.00 XCD
	Expenses:Sundry 15.00 XCD

# A split of nothing, which a book can hold and beancount has no posting for.
2024-02-03 * "Refund settled against itself"
	Assets:Bank -40.00 XCD
	Expenses:Sundry 40.00 XCD
	Expenses:Sundry 0.00 XCD
